scope.implemented: Native integer initialization, alternate-frame movement, respawn, four-word RNG recurrence, six-row sprite frame progression, two draw-object submissions, zero-strength release, performance initialization gate, full saved records and clock phase.

method.oracle: Bounded interpretation of isolated original x86 functions over private byte arrays. Original RNG, cosine table and wind helper interpreted; renderer submission/clip and release are controlled leaves. No original process or Win32 call is started.

boundaries: The portable owner supplies 60 Hz render frames and preserves the native alternate-call toggle. The original main-loop frequency has not been established; real-time timing is a compatibility approximation.

The four-word RNG recurrence and saved words match the isolated native functions for supplied initial words. Its state belongs to this effect and does not consume the same process-wide stream as native audio, UI and other effects; native startup seeding is not claimed.

Native draw objects 1 and 7 are placed in the current scene compositor outer petal groups 0 and 4. Source crops and native quad arguments are verified; exact native sorting with every scene-object priority and GPU blend implementation is not claimed.

Physical validation decodes original read-only SACRA02 and renders through the portable desktop engine. It never starts the original game executable and is not a screenshot comparison against a running original game.
A catch-up call is capped at 3600 portable render frames. The host freezes engine time during suspension; this cap bounds malformed elapsed callers.
audit_output_guard: Final audit source shares DesktopRouteAudit real-path output guard; rerun against the unchanged frozen player passed the same checks.
